about: Plain-language summary of what the agent has learned about each person's tastes. Shown and editable under Settings on the calendar. When a person edits their summary, the agent treats every statement in it as correct and keeps it.

aaron.summary:
Starting point (from what I know of you):
- Big yes: repertory and revival film — noir, Hitchcock, Lynch, character actors, sad and humane stories.
- Electronic, experimental and ambient music; DJ nights at artist-run spaces like Current Space.
- Adventurous jazz in small rooms (Keystone Korner).
- DIY electronics, synths and maker fairs.
- Historic buildings, old houses, Victorian history and walking tours.
- Photography and contemporary art, small galleries.
- Storytelling, author talks and interview-style events.
- Gardening and nature programs.
- Less likely: arena pop and tribute acts, kids-only programming, sports, pub crawls.

From your flags so far (9 Interested, none Not interested):
- You leaned toward free, outdoor and community events: Doors Open Baltimore, the Lantern Parade, Mushroom City Arts Festival and a microgreens workshop at Filbert Street Garden.
- Also flagged: a drum & bass night (Junglist Heights), the Bmore Horror Film Fest, Beth Lapides' comedy show, Everyman Theatre's Different Words for Happiness and a free chamber concert (Trio Sirènes).
- Takeaway: comedy, theater and classical concerts are more welcome than I assumed, and festivals and gardening deserve more room.

stacey.summary: Nothing learned yet. As Stacey flags events Interested or Not interested, this fills in. You can also write what she likes here and the agent will use it.
